technical.summary: ABBV shows long-term uptrend structure (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish, above cloud) but lacks short-term momentum confirmation with price below key moving averages, negative money flow, and oversold oscillators suggesting consolidation rather than immediate swing entry.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no senior conviction; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (225.92), and recession risk dominate; earnings in 41 days adds moderate event risk; falling DXY provides minor offset for multinational ABBV.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term uptrend structure (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with price near support (142.69) in extreme fear environment (VIX 225.92) offers contrarian entry for mean reversion.
